review.intent: Original stage89 desert is opaque across all pixels. This revision removes the mistakenly requested black band and restores continuous small-rubble terrain to the bottom; no dunes, cactus or buildings added.
review.style: Pale peach haze, muted reddish rubble and soft distant hills now retain the original intent, with fine natural rock detail following Skurfa finish.
review.layout: Three-repeat native-size comparison restores the original broad sky/terrain ratio, low hazy hill profile and full-width ground strip. All target1536x1024 pixels occupied; original source is fully opaque.
review.wrap: Boundary still has a visible vertical sky/haze color step on repetition. Edge difference8.70 versus original4.16. Intent corrected, but keep outside installed mod until repeat boundary repair.
